purpose: I run a small landscaping company and need something in writing with a homeowner because this project keeps changing every week. Originally it was just mowing and trimming, then now they want mulch, sprinkler fixes, fence cleanup, hauling junk, and extra flower beds. I don’t mind doing more work but I need clear approval before extras, payment timing, and what happens if weather delays things. They still owe me from the last two visits and keep saying they’ll add it to the final bill. I also bring my own trailer and equipment so if something gets damaged that needs to be clear too. Need something practical and fair, not hostile, that keeps the job moving and avoids arguments.
title: Agreement
